items.title: futureteck/ICT_Automated_Trading_System
items.author: futureteck
items.text:
This is a trading bot implemented the Inner Circle Trading (ICT) methodology. The bot is coded in Python with majority of the code being generated by GitHub 
Copilot, with some tweaks from me.There are two planned versions of the bot, one that's hard-coded and another that uses a machine learning algorithm to 
learn how best to automate trades. The idea is to compare the performance of the two across a period of time to see who generates more profit.

raw.description: A trading bot implementing the ICT trading methodology
